WITH "first_opening" AS (SELECT MIN("date") AS "earliest_date" FROM "account"), "first_month_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_opening" AS "f" WHERE "a"."date" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".earliest_date)::DATE AND "a"."date" < (DATE_TRUNC('month', "f".earliest_date) + INTERVAL '1 month')::DATE) SELECT "d".a2, "d".a8 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "first_month_districts" AS "fmd" ON "fmd".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a8 = (SELECT MAX("d2".a8) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "first_month_districts" AS "fmd2" ON "fmd2".district_id = "d2".district_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" ORDER BY a16 DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 HAVING COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) = (SELECT MAX("x".avg_amount) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("l2".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".account_id) AS "avg_amount" FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l2" ON "l2".account_id = "a2".account_id AND "l2".status IN ('C', 'D') WHERE "d2".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" ORDER BY a16 DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY "d2".district_id) AS "x") LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day') >= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "qualifying" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

WITH "serving_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch".district_id FROM "district" AS "branch" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a10::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "serving_districts" AS "sd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "sd".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loan_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000), "qualifying" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "a".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "cd".client_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "od".client_id = "c".client_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "od".account_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "od".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold'), "dg" AS (SELECT "q".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a13 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "q".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "s" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(salary::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "dg" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "dg".district_id, "dg".inhabitants, "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_ratio FROM "s" INNER JOIN "dg" ON "dg".gender = "s".gender AND "dg".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC, "dg".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch_district" ON "branch_district".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold' AND CAST("branch_district".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000), "totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account > 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM("t".amount), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a8, "d".a11, "d".a13 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "regional_averages" AS (SELECT a3, ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_unemployment" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY a3), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT a3, a2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC, a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a3, a2, a8 FROM "qualifying_districts") AS "distinct_districts") SELECT "ra".a3 AS "region", "ra".avg_salary AS "average_district_salary", "ra".avg_unemployment AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", "rd".a2 AS "most_populous_district" FROM "regional_averages" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".a3 = "ra".a3 AND "rd".rn = 1 ORDER BY "ra".a3 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "district_crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "crimes_1996" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4), "top_three" AS (SELECT * FROM "district_crimes" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(translate(a2, 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ', 'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ')) ASC LIMIT 3), "summary" AS (SELECT (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::NUMERIC) FROM "top_three") AS "three_avg", (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::NUMERIC) FROM "district_crimes") AS "all_avg") SELECT "t".a2 AS "district_name", "t".crimes_1996, ROUND("s".three_avg, 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND("s".all_avg, 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND("s".three_avg - "s".all_avg, 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "summary" AS "s" ORDER BY "t".inhabitants DESC, lower(translate("t".a2, 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ', 'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ')) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "c"."type" IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')), "ranked" AS (SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "fewest_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts") SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = fewest_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "region" AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_tx" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "o".account_id, "o".district_id, "lt".balance FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id), "district_summary" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", AVG("ab".balance)::NUMERIC AS "average_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".a2), "ranked" AS (SELECT district_name FROM "district_summary" ORDER BY average_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, ROUND(average_balance, 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance" FROM "district_summary" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "loan_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "top_loans"), "populous" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "loan_districts" AS "ld" ON "ld".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "p".district_id, "p".inhabitants, ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "populous" AS "p" CROSS JOIN "loan_districts" AS "ld" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ld".district_id GROUP BY "p".district_id, "p".inhabitants LIMIT 501

WITH "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "a".account_id FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000), "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "da".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "da".district_id), "district_summary" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, "da".district_name, "da".region, "da".population, "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "da".population AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE(SUM("o".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "da".account_id) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "da".district_id LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "da".account_id GROUP BY "da".district_id, "da".district_name, "da".region, "da".population, "w".total_withdrawn) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_summary" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "a".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", "c".district_id AS "client_home_district" FROM "disp" AS "p" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id WHERE "p".client_id = 3541), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT("c".client_id) AS "regional_home_clients" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district"), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "ac".account_id, "ac".opened_date, "ac".frequency, "ac".district_name, "ac".region, CASE WHEN "ac".district_id = "ac".client_home_district THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "ac".average_salary, COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tt".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tt".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tt".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tt".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tt".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rs".regional_home_clients, "rd".most_populous_district, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "rd".population_rank FROM "accessible" AS "ac" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "ac".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "ac".account_id INNER JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "ac".region INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "ac".district_id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, "ac".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "year_num", district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER, district_id), "yearly" AS (SELECT year_num, SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent::NUMERIC / accounts_opened), 2) AS "avg_district_amount_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY year_num) SELECT year_num::TEXT AS "year", accounts_opened, total_amount_lent, avg_district_amount_per_account FROM "yearly" ORDER BY year_num ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", "t".balance AS "end_of_day_account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "l".account_id AND "tr".date = "l".date ORDER BY "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "t" ON TRUE WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

WITH "issued_cards" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a10 AS "district_average_salary", "di".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_stats" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "ic".client_id, "ic".gender, "ic".birth_date, "ic".card_type, "ic".age_at_issue, COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "ic".district_name, "ic".district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "ic".gender ORDER BY "ic".age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "issued_cards" AS "ic" LEFT JOIN "loan_stats" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ic".account_id ORDER BY "ic".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "t".amount IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "t".amount END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".client_id = 2823 AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "d".a2 AS "branch_district", "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "female_loans"), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "region_loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salary" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_district_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "r".client_id, "r".amount, "r".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("r".payments * "r".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("r".payments * "r".duration - "r".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "r".status AS "loan_status", "r".branch_district, "r".region, COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC(20, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "r".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > "r".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".region_loan_count, "rs".avg_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "r".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age" FROM "ranked_loans" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "r".account_id INNER JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "r".region INNER JOIN "region_salary" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "r".region WHERE "r".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_exposure" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region_name", ("d".a8 + "d".a9) AS "inhabitants", COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a8, "d".a9), "region_totals" AS (SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM(inhabitants) AS "combined_population", SUM(account_count) AS "total_accounts" FROM "district_exposure" GROUP BY region_name), "winning_region" AS (SELECT region_name FROM "region_totals" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "de".region_name AS "region", "de".district_name AS "district", "rt".district_count, "rt".combined_population, "rt".total_accounts FROM "district_exposure" AS "de" INNER JOIN "region_totals" AS "rt" ON "rt".region_name = "de".region_name INNER JOIN "winning_region" AS "wr" ON "wr".region_name = "de".region_name ORDER BY "de".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened_1997", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 100000 LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "tx_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "l".account_id GROUP BY "l".account_id) SELECT "g".account_id, "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tx_totals".received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tx_totals".withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("loan_counts".loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tx_totals".counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("tx_totals".counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "g" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "g".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "tx_totals" ON "tx_totals".account_id = "g".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" ON "loan_counts".account_id = "g".account_id ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, "g".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "branch_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "owner".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner" ON "owner".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner".client_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "account_metrics" AS (SELECT "ba".account_id, "ba".opened_date, "ba".gender, "ba".birth_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id WHERE "cd".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "card_count", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "loan_count", (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".status = 'B') > 0 THEN 'defaulted' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D')) > 0 THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31') AS "loan_standing", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01') AS "transaction_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "money_in", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')) AS "money_out", (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01') AS "peak_balance", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "ba".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba") SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_years, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "account_metrics" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "dp".client_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic'), "owners_by_district" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "owner_clients" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY district_id), "outgoing" AS (SELECT "e".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_accounts", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "e".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("o".owner_clients, 0) AS "owner_clients", COALESCE("x".external_accounts, 0) AS "external_accounts", COALESCE("x".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "owners_by_district" AS "o" ON "o".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "outgoing" AS "x" ON "x".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("district".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date < '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a13::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "female_clients" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "female_clients".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".birth_date, "d".a11 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ac".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' ORDER BY "c".birth_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r853" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r854".driverid = "r853".driverid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r853".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r853".raceid = 853 AND "r854".raceid = 854 AND "r853".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r854".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "results".positiontext <> '1') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "non_victory_percentage" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "results".driverid = "drivers".driverid INNER JOIN "races" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid WHERE "drivers".forename = 'Lewis' AND "drivers".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "races".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points_total" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid LEFT JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "winner".position = 1 AND "last_finisher".position IS NOT NULL AND "last_finisher".laps = (SELECT MAX("res".laps) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position IS NOT NULL) AND "last_finisher".position = (SELECT MAX("res".position) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position IS NOT NULL AND "res".laps = "last_finisher".laps) AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "dr".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "dr" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "dr".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "dr".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "dr".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "ra".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("cr".points) AS "score", "co".name, "co".nationality FROM "constructorresults" AS "cr" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "cr".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "co" ON "cr".constructorid = "co".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "co".constructorid, "co".name, "co".nationality ORDER BY SUM("cr".points) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "d".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, CASE WHEN "x".milliseconds IS NOT NULL THEN ("x".milliseconds / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("x".milliseconds % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("x".milliseconds % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "x".milliseconds % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "x".milliseconds % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("x".milliseconds % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "milliseconds" FROM "laptimes" GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000 AND MIN(milliseconds) < 120000) AS "x" ON "x".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "x".driverid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "c".name = 'Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours' ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "years" AS (SELECT 2002::BIGINT AS "year" UNION ALL SELECT 2003 UNION ALL SELECT 2004 UNION ALL SELECT 2005 UNION ALL SELECT 2006 UNION ALL SELECT 2007 UNION ALL SELECT 2008 UNION ALL SELECT 2009), "years2" AS (SELECT year FROM "years" UNION ALL SELECT 2010 UNION ALL SELECT 2011 UNION ALL SELECT 2012 UNION ALL SELECT 2013), "eligible_races" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "r".raceid, "r".year FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 AND "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19), "pit_counts" AS (SELECT "er".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "eligible_races" AS "er" INNER JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "er".raceid GROUP BY "er".year) SELECT "y".year, COALESCE("pc".pit_stop_count, 0) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "years2" AS "y" LEFT JOIN "pit_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".year = "y".year ORDER BY "y".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 > '2:00.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "chosen_driver" AS (SELECT * FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "r".name AS "race_name", "r".date AS "race_date" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "res".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1), "starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".raceid) AS "race_starts" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "cd".forename || ' ' || "cd".surname AS "full_name", "cd".nationality, "fw".race_name, "fw".race_date, "starts".race_starts FROM "chosen_driver" AS "cd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "starts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "q".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra2" ON "q2".raceid = "ra2".raceid WHERE "ra2".year = 2017 AND "ra2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "chinese_gp" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL), "earliest" AS (SELECT time FROM "chinese_gp" ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1), "selected_race" AS (SELECT "c".raceid, "c".year FROM "chinese_gp" AS "c" WHERE "c".time = (SELECT time FROM "earliest") ORDER BY "c".year DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "sr".year AS "season_year", "winner".time AS "winner_time", "runner_up".time AS "runner_up_time", "runner_up".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds AS "runner_up_gap_milliseconds" FROM "selected_race" AS "sr" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "sr".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "runner_up" ON "runner_up".raceid = "sr".raceid AND "runner_up".position = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part(split_part("q".q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER + (('0.' || split_part("q".q3, '.', 2))::NUMERIC)) < 98 LIMIT 501

WITH "departments" AS (SELECT "m".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) FILTER (WHERE "mb".member_id IS NOT NULL) AS "majors_held", COUNT("mb".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".link_to_major = "m".major_id WHERE "m".department IN (SELECT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "m".department) SELECT department, majors_offered, majors_held, ROUND(member_count::NUMERIC / majors_offered, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "departments" ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mb".position = 'Member' AND "mb".member_id IN (SELECT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mb".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "m".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "m".department ORDER BY "m".department ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", COUNT("ex".expense_id) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "et".event_name FROM "event_totals" AS "et" LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "et".event_id WHERE "et".total_spending <= "et".total_budget ORDER BY COALESCE("pc".purchases, 0) DESC, "et".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501
