SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "gender".gender, COUNT("qualifying".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' AND "s".gender_id IN (SELECT id FROM "gender" WHERE gender IN ('Male', 'Female')) GROUP BY "s".id, "s".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".gender_id = "gender".id WHERE "gender".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "gender".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_hulk".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_hulk" ON "ha_hulk".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_hulk" ON "a_hulk".id = "ha_hulk".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a_hulk".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_heights" AS (SELECT height_cm, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0), "tallest" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "ranked_heights" AS "r" ON "s".height_cm = "r".height_cm WHERE "r".height_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "different_superpowers" FROM "tallest" AS "t" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "t".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "a".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND ("r".race = '-' OR "s".race_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("power_counts".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "power_counts" ON "power_counts".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' LIMIT 501

WITH "cryo_holders" AS (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "adjacent_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" INNER JOIN "cryo_holders" AS "ch" ON "ch".hero_id = "hp2".hero_id)), "portfolio_sizes" AS (SELECT "ah".hero_id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "adjacent_heroes" AS "ah" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ah".hero_id GROUP BY "ah".hero_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "portfolio_sizes" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dp".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "m".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "m" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "m".publisher_id = "mp".id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "m".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "a" ON "s".race_id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".race_id IN (SELECT "s2".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "s2" WHERE "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s2".race_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s2".gender_id = (SELECT id FROM "gender" WHERE gender = 'Female')) = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s"."publisher_id" = "p"."id" WHERE "a"."alignment" = 'Good' AND ("p"."publisher_name" <> 'DC Comics' OR "p"."publisher_name" IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "blackwulf" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".publisher_id, "a".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "b" ON "b".eye_colour_id = "a".eye_colour_id AND "b".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "b".publisher_id <> "a".publisher_id WHERE "a".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "a".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL) AS "shared_colours" ON "shared_colours".publisher_id = "h".publisher_id AND "shared_colours".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id WHERE "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "target".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "target".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "target2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "target2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "target2".full_name = 'Charles Chandler' AND "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "counts") ORDER BY "r".race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("q".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG("p".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:alpha:]]+[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]]+' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 THEN "s".height_cm END)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 THEN "s".weight_kg END)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "h".id <> "target".id AND "h".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "hp".power_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0), "counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "lightest" AS "l" ON "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "superhero".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "superhero".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".colour IN (SELECT "brown_eye_colour".colour FROM "superhero" AS "brown_hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_eye_colour" ON "brown_hero".eye_colour_id = "brown_eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair_colour" ON "brown_hero".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair_colour".id WHERE "brown_hair_colour".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "target".id AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "count_difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5)) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_inpatients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(CAST("rnp" AS INTEGER)) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "l"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l"."rnp" AS INTEGER) = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bil" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c"."date", "c"."id", "c"."sex", "c"."birthday" FROM "candidates" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "c"."T-BIL" = "h".max_bil LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis <> 0) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 10) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "p".id HAVING MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s2".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' AND "l"."plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_date_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' AND "l".dna NOT ILIKE '%negative%'), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, dna, MAX(dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "max_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, dna FROM "ranked" WHERE dna::NUMERIC = max_level ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 16) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l"."id" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l"."id" HAVING BOOL_OR("l"."hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."hct" <= 29 OR "l"."hct" >= 52)) AND BOOL_OR("l"."rnp" IN ('64', '256'))) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal_result".patient_id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal_result".patient_id IS NULL) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id AS "patient_id" FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "normal_result" ON "normal_result".patient_id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IS NOT NULL THEN "p".id END), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '1000', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_creatinine_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "u"."T-CHO", "u".admission, "u".id FROM (SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id, 1 AS "group_order" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id, 2 AS "group_order" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL)) AS "u" ORDER BY "u".group_order ASC, "u".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "top_level" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS "highest_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT "e".id, "e".rnp AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "top_level" AS "t" ON "e".rnp_level = "t".highest_level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" = '300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=1000' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '4') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".id IS NOT NULL AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "l".id FROM "latest_lab" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "l".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "s" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "p"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "p"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l"."rnp"::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."cre" < 1.5 AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT id AS "patient_id", date AS "laboratory_test_date", rnp AS "anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp = '256' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450)) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "measurements_with_ldh_below_500" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "maxima" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient_rnp") SELECT "pr".id, "pr".sex, "pr".highest_rnp AS "highest_rnp_level" FROM "patient_rnp" AS "pr" INNER JOIN "maxima" AS "m" ON "pr".highest_rnp = "m".max_rnp LIMIT 501

WITH "first_dates" AS (SELECT id, MIN(date) AS "first_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "first_dates" AS "f" ON "l".id = "f".id AND "l".date = "f".first_date WHERE "l".got < 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 10 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_proteinuria" AS (SELECT "l".id AS "patient_id", "p".sex, "l".date AS "test_date", "l"."U-PRO" AS "proteinuria_level", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT patient_id, sex, test_date, proteinuria_level FROM "ranked_proteinuria" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT id, MAX(gpt) AS "highest_gpt" FROM "laboratory" WHERE gpt < 60 GROUP BY id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "normal_gpt" AS "n" ON "n".id = "q".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "q".id ORDER BY "n".highest_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "id", "p".sex AS "sex" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_results" AS (SELECT "ep".id, "ep".care_setting, BOOL_OR("l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible_patients" AS "ep" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "ep".id GROUP BY "ep".id, "ep".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_results" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".date, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "li".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission = '+' OR admission = '+(' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT "s".setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "latest" AS "l" ON "l".id = "s".id GROUP BY "s".setting ORDER BY "s".setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l"), "counts" AS (SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "most_recent" AS "m" ON "m".id = "p".id WHERE "m".rn = 1 AND "m".rnp IN ('32', '64', '256') GROUP BY "p".sex) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN n ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'M' THEN n ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count" FROM "latest" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND admission IN ('+', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id AND "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission ILIKE '%+%' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "patients_with_age" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".admission, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(completed_age), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patients_with_age" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' AND ("e".diagnosis = 'SjS' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE '%, SjS' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE 'SjS, %' OR "e".diagnosis LIKE '%, SjS, %') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm" ON "sm".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("sm".sm = 'negative' OR "sm".sm = '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "p"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "p"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'TR') AND (("p"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "p"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 30) OR "p"."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300')) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rbc_lab" ON "rbc_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("rbc_lab".rbc <= 3.5 OR "rbc_lab".rbc >= 6.0) AND "rnp_lab".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "rnp_lab".rnp <> '0' AND "rnp_lab".rnp <> 'negative' ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date >= "p".birthday + INTERVAL '0 years' AND "l".date < ("p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f') THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS "bond_type", CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "a".atom_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "bond_groups" AS (SELECT molecule_id, BOOL_AND(bond_type = '-') AS "all_single" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id), "groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COALESCE("bg".all_single, FALSE) THEN 'all single bonds' ELSE 'other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond_groups" AS "bg" ON "bg".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE WHEN bond_group = 'all single bonds' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "ax" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "mx" ON "mx".molecule_id = "ax".molecule_id WHERE "mx".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND ("a".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected") OR "a".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM "connected")) GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' AND ("a2".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected") OR "a2".atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM "connected")) GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonding_with_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "sulfur" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "sulfur".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "sulfur".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "other_a" WHERE "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "n" WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "n".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "qualifying" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "q".molecule_id, "q".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id AND "a".element = "q".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "q".molecule_id, "q".element) SELECT molecule_id, SUM(bond_count) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond_counts" GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", molecule_id, label AS "carcinogenicity_label", atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_ended_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id2" WHERE "b"."molecule_id" = (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element = 'y') AND ("a".element = 'h' OR "a2".element = 'h') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a1".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND (("a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element <> 'c') OR ("a2".element = 'c' AND "a1".element <> 'c')) GROUP BY "a1".element ORDER BY "a1".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("c".atom_id, "c".atom_id2), GREATEST("c".atom_id, "c".atom_id2))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0 UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "single_only" ON "single_only".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "atom".element AS "element_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "bond".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "bond" INNER JOIN "connected" ON "connected".bond_id = "bond".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" ON "atom".atom_id = "connected".atom_id WHERE "bond".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "atom".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
